name: summary
description: A 1–3 sentence summary of this record's purpose and content.

aiGuidance.purpose: One to three sentences saying what this record is and why it exists. Used in indexes, previews, navigation and search results, where it is read alone.
aiGuidance.extraction: Plain text, no markdown. Lead with the subject rather than "This record...". Write it so it makes sense out of context, in a list beside fifty other summaries. Say what the record is and why it exists, not how it is organised — "covers three topics" tells a reader nothing.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: No headings, lists, code blocks, tables or links — this field is rendered as plain text. No RFC 2119 keywords: a requirement stated only in a summary is invisible to conformance. Do not exceed three sentences; if the subject will not fit, the record is covering more than one subject.
